image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a large adult common iguana (Iguana iguana) perched on a thick tree branch. The iguana has greyish-green skin with darker banding, a prominent dorsal crest of spines running down its neck and back, and a large subtympanic shield below the ear. Its head is triangular with a visible dewlap, and it is looking towards the left. The background consists of blurred green foliage, indicating an arboreal environment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly triangular and robust. A significant fold of skin (dewlap) is visible hanging from the lower jaw/throat area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye is large, the pupil appears round, and the iris has a yellowish-golden hue consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, large, pale circular scale is clearly visible on the side of the head, below the ear region, matching the description of the subtympanic shield.
The torso appears thick and muscular, consistent with a mature iguana.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The iguana exhibits adult coloration: predominantly greyish-green with darker, broad banding patterns on the body and limbs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A continuous row of sharp, spine-like scales is clearly visible starting from the neck and extending down the back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: High-resolution texture shows fine granular scales on the body and larger, smoother plate-like scales on the snout and cheeks.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front limbs are visible, appearing muscular. The digits are long, and claws are visible on the feet gripping the branch.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While part of the tail base is visible, the full length and lateral compression cannot be fully verified as the tail extends out of the frame or is obscured by the body angle.
